title: 20-20-20 Eye Break
description: Follow the 20-20-20 rule to reduce eye strain: every 20 minutes, look 20 feet away for 20 seconds.
how_to_play:
1. The app will track your screen time.
2. Every 20 minutes, you'll get a reminder to look 20 feet away.
3. Focus on something far for 20 seconds.
4. Log each completed break to track your eye health streak.
